summary: Brookfield Wealth Solutions Ltd., a Bermuda-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements and MD&A for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, together with CEO and CFO certifications under Canadian law. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is disclosed; the exhibit is an ordinary quarterly reporting package incorporated by reference into the Form F-3 shelf. Total assets rose to $203.9 billion from $157.2 billion at year-end 2025. No special-situation event; no deal terms to monitor.
